stocks.name: Microsoft
drivers: Recurring software margins and cash conversion
stocks.question: Can cloud and AI demand earn an adequate return on the infrastructure required to serve it?
stocks.countercase: Strong revenue growth can coexist with weaker owner cash flow when capital spending and depreciation rise.
stocks.invalidation: Reassess if cloud growth weakens while infrastructure commitments and cash outflows keep rising.

stocks.name: NVIDIA
drivers: Product transitions, supply and gross margins
Export access and competing compute architectures
stocks.question: How much durable demand remains after the current infrastructure buildout?
stocks.countercase: Exceptional current margins and growth may normalize as customers improve utilization or deploy alternative chips.
stocks.invalidation: Reassess if customer spending slows, inventory builds, or pricing power deteriorates across product cycles.

stocks.name: Alphabet
drivers: Search usage, monetization and traffic costs
AI infrastructure spending and regulatory remedies
stocks.question: Can AI investment defend search economics while expanding cloud profit?
stocks.countercase: Cheap-looking earnings can be misleading if AI changes search monetization or materially increases the cost per query.
stocks.invalidation: Reassess if search economics weaken persistently or capital intensity rises without corresponding cash generation.

stocks.name: Amazon
drivers: AWS growth, margins and capacity investment
Advertising contribution and free cash flow
stocks.question: Can cloud and advertising profits fund growth while retail efficiency improves?
stocks.countercase: Consolidated margins can conceal very different businesses; lease obligations and capital spending can absorb operating gains.
stocks.invalidation: Reassess if AWS returns weaken and retail cash generation fails to offset investment requirements.

stocks.name: Meta
drivers: AI spending versus engagement and advertiser returns
stocks.question: Will AI-driven monetization justify the growing investment base?
stocks.countercase: Better ad performance may already be priced in while infrastructure spending and speculative projects reduce cash available to owners.
stocks.invalidation: Reassess if ad growth and monetization weaken while investment commitments continue to expand.

stocks.name: Apple
drivers: Device replacement demand and installed base
Regional demand, regulation and capital returns
stocks.question: Can ecosystem cash generation support the growth expectations embedded in the share price?
stocks.countercase: Buybacks can support EPS while underlying demand slows; services economics may face regulatory pressure.
stocks.invalidation: Reassess if installed-base monetization weakens alongside sustained device demand deterioration.

stocks.name: Tesla
stocks.question: How much of today's valuation depends on businesses that have yet to demonstrate durable cash flows?
stocks.countercase: A model anchored to current operations may miss successful autonomy or robotics commercialization. Those outcomes need separate evidence and scenarios.
stocks.invalidation: Reassess if core cash generation deteriorates while future-business assumptions become harder to substantiate.
